CHIEF TYPE/PROVENANCE REVIEW — BLOCK on the current uncommitted S1-S4 provider slice, bound to source hashes acquire/output.scala 3e852408..., view/output.scala c4d62f3e..., codec/output.scala 1f52de2c..., codec/output_acquire.scala 71c2d6a0..., spec 53ab5245....

1. BLOCKER, fabricated scientific license: AdmittedViewBasis.of (view/output.scala:509-521) accepts arbitrary source/build checksums plus caller-minted receipt ids whenever the three tags have the expected shape. StoryOutputResult.admittedBasis (:667-697) checks only sourceChecksum; it never matches buildReceiptChecksum or BasisAuthority against acquisition.buildReceipt. The wire decoder calls this factory directly (codec/output.scala:616-623). Thus a caller can publish ValidatedBuild, HumanAdjudicated, or ResearcherReviewedFixture authority without the corresponding admitted provenance. This contradicts accepted spec section 8 and C6. A typed id does not establish admission. Split wire claims from admitted values, and make admission consume and match the actual acquisition/build/adjudication/fixture receipt; add mutants for wrong build checksum, wrong authority receipt, and fixture relabel with the same source checksum.

2. BLOCKER, fabricated profile certification: ProfileReceipt/ProfileCourtOutcome are public product data and Passed carries no evidence (view/output.scala:146-182). certificationMatches (:912-924) accepts any nonempty set of caller-named courts so long as all are labelled Passed; it neither derives the required court set from the profile schema nor proves the verifier execution. Existing test code constructs Satisfied with copy (:721-741), demonstrating the door. This violates C9/C10: local-open may become Satisfied only after the exact courts run. Use an unforgeable verified receipt produced from an exact required court plan plus evidence; wire input must decode as an untrusted claim or be revalidated. Add a one-arbitrary-passed-court mutant.

3. BLOCKER, decorative report receipt: ReportReceipt is freely constructible and decoded directly (view/output.scala:412-418; codec/output.scala:397-415). StoryOutputResult.reportArtifacts (:647-665) validates only role/media type, so a produced report whose inputChecksum belongs to another result is accepted. Bind each outcome receipt to a deterministic declared report input/config identity and reject a foreign-input receipt; add the exact cross-result mutation court.

The non-case classes and external Mirror/copy probes uphold only generated-door closure; they do not prove the factories establish the joined claims. Per AGENTS Cartesian-product rule, these three are the missing semantic doors.

GOVERNANCE GATE: exact spec acceptance did not grant public vocabulary, dependency, child-bead, candidate, or landing authority. Do not commit/propose this slice yet. I will rule the codec -> view topology separately; public names remain conditional on repairing the authority boundaries and receiving an exact path/gate assignment. No reserved file was edited by this review.
